items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to take equal weights of four sweet spices
items.object: sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum, frankincense

items.quote: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:
items.claim: Moses was instructed to make a holy perfume using apothecary art from the spices
items.mechanism: after the art of the apothecary, tempered together

items.quote: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.
items.claim: Moses was instructed to beat the incense into very fine powder

items.quote: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.
items.claim: Moses was instructed to place the incense before the testimony in the tabernacle
items.place: before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation
